reviews.text: It's always a great experience. A very caring group of people. I have been bringing my cats there for thirty plus years.

The folks at McKillip, especially Dr Hopkins, are the best around.
They helped me provide extended care for my super senior dog Ozzie and made sure his last years and moments were comfortable and happy.
It feels like Cheers any time I bring in my guy Lenny now. They truly care about your pets and have great references for services not provided by them.
I moved out of Chicago and still bring Lenny into the city rather than find a new place because we love it there so much.
We wish Dr Hopkins could be our human doctor - she’s an absolute rockstar!
I can’t thank the people there enough for everything they’ve done for my pack!
Good for walk ins but expensive

Dr. Hopkins and the entire team at McKillip are the most wonderful veterinary staff I've ever worked with. Everyone is so kind and understanding. We found a cancerous mass on my dog and despite a few other smaller concerns, the mass was removed within a month and my dog back on the mend. They have been so good to us through this entire ordeal. I have already recommended friends go to them and will trust them with all of my animal care needs.

I had such a great experience at McKillip Animal Hospital and can’t recommend them enough. I’m still new to the city and hadn’t found a vet yet, but now I absolutely have one.

I came in pretty panicked because my dog suddenly developed a hematoma on his ear and I had no idea where to go or what to do. From the moment I walked in, the evening staff on 4/28 were incredibly welcoming and professional. They took the time to explain everything clearly so I felt informed and reassured during a stressful moment.

A huge thank you to Dr. Ashely Hopkins, who was absolutely amazing. I arrived just 40 minutes before closing, and she still went above and beyond, they were able to perform the procedure my dog needed right then and there. That level of care, urgency, and compassion meant everything to me.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy, kind, and reliable animal hospital in Lakeview or anywhere in Chicago, this is the place. I’m so grateful I found them.

I’ve had a really disappointing experience with this clinic. My dog has been on a monthly prescription for gabapentin, and this month the refill was declined without any notification to me. I only found out when I went to pick it up.

When I called, I was told they would not refill it without an exam—which I understand as a policy—but refusing even a short bridge supply and failing to communicate the denial in advance puts pets at risk of missing necessary medication.

This could have easily been avoided with basic communication. A simple call or message would have allowed me to plan ahead and schedule an appointment. Instead, I was left scrambling the day my dog needs his medication.

Really disappointed in the lack of communication and consideration for continuity of care.
They care for my baby as if she was their own💗💗 …

Great hospital and very easy to be seen. I’ve been here a handful amount of times with no appointments needed. I usually see the guy doctor. This time I seen Dr. Hopkins , she was such a breath of fresh air. She & the technician explained to me things very thoroughly and easy to understand,. I really like that she goes over an estimated cost of the treatment plan before getting started. The only negative thing I will say is that every single time I’ve been there , there’s always lady with short blondish/greyish hair talking really out loud with no decorum. It’s really uncomfortable having to hear her curse out of no where or grunting. Prices are a bit high as well, but i guess it due to the location. Other than that the rest of the staff is really nice and positive. I do recommend this place!

In full transparency, I had never met Dr. Hopkins before and was a little hesitant based on some of the reviews I’d read.

But I had a really positive experience with her. My dog was having loose stool—thankfully nothing serious—and they recommended a stool panel and some medication. Dr. Hopkins was easy to talk to and very understanding, especially when I mentioned I wanted to be conservative with treatment for financial reasons. She clearly has a lot of experience and offered plenty of helpful tips and advice, which I really appreciated. I’d have no problem seeing her again.

Yes, the clinic does have longer wait times—I went on a Tuesday at 9:00 a.m. and waited a little over an hour—but the ability to walk in without an appointment is a big plus.

The front desk staff are kind, and when I declined the optional probiotics and IV fluids, the vet tech removed them with no pushback at all.

Also, McKillips had the best pricing of any place I called. The office visit was $84, the fecal test was $78, and the antibiotics were $25.70—way more reasonable than other quotes I received. I also got texts the results the next morning.

We’ve been bringing our pet here for about three years now and will definitely continue to be clients

Ended up having a catheter put on my cat, because he had bladder stones, and immediately drove to the emergency vet to have it removed. Emergency vet said this never should have happened. Wasted $1400. I was pressured into this and didn’t know what was going on. Unprofessional care. My cat also needed immediate surgery for the stones, which they neglected to tell me how fatal and timely this was — instead their solution was something no other vet would have done.
Their friendly and service is great
Staff and vets are very kind, helpful and professional.

Took my pet for a routine check up. The vet A. Hopkins had ZERO bedside manner and a complete GOD complex. She was more concerned about upselling me treatments for my pet than actually explaining what my pet was experiencing. …

Great experience in and out. Fairly priced for services very knowledgeable of many breeds of dogs and cats
